personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive, and classic barbershop experience driven by dark midnight tones, wood textures, and antique gold accents.

spacing.rule: Generous luxury spacing. Elements must breathe. No cramped list items or grids.

do's: Use for sticky headers over scrolling content
Use for hero/featured cards as a frosted overlay on photo backdrops
Ensure translucent tinted base underneath foreground content for readability (≥75% of surface opacity)
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields, body text regions, or the entire screen
Don't stack more than 2 blur surfaces per screen

screens.name: Auth (Login/Register)
screens.purpose: Secure JWT authentication entry point for clients, barbers, and admins.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with heavy dark gradient scrim. Clean input fields (surfaceTertiary) with labels above. Dominant gold primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Client)
screens.purpose: Launchpad for booking, displaying upcoming appointments, top barbers, and featured services.

states.error: Failed to load feed + Retry button

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Large 'Next Appointment' widget if booked. Horizontal scroll for 'Top Barbers' (glass cards with photos). Quick access grid for services. Dominant sticky CTA 'Book Appointment'.

screens.name: Service & Product Catalog
screens.purpose: List available cuts/services (price, duration) and products (beard oils, etc).

states.empty: Illustration of empty vintage tools + 'No items available' + CTA

screens.layout: Vertical list view. Image on left, details and tabular-lined price on right. Use surfaceSecondary for list items with divider. Sticky cart/book CTA at bottom if items are selected.

screens.name: Barber Profiles & Gallery
screens.purpose: Showcase a barber's specialties, ratings, and portfolio of previous cuts.
screens.layout: Hero image banner (barber cutting hair) with gradient scrim and glassmorphism back button. Barber name in Cormorant Garamond. Tabs for 'About', 'Services', and 'Gallery' (2-column masonry or grid). Sticky 'Book Barber' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Booking Flow

states.empty: No slots available for this date

screens.layout: Progress indicator at top. Clean lists for selection. Calendar picker with clear disabled states. Available time slots as pills (brandTertiary for unselected, brandPrimary for selected). Sticky 'Continue/Confirm' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: My Appointments
screens.purpose: History and upcoming schedules for the logged-in user.

states.empty: Vintage chair icon + 'No upcoming appointments' + 'Book Now' CTA

screens.layout: Segmented control (glassmorphism) for 'Upcoming' vs 'Past'. Stacked cards showing date, time, barber, service, and status badge.

screens.name: Barber Agenda View
screens.purpose: Barber-specific dashboard to view today's schedule and update statuses.
screens.layout: Timeline or vertical list of the day's appointments. High contrast typography for times. Swipe actions or tap to open bottom sheet to update status (Completed, No-show).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage barbers, services, products, schedules, and global appointments.
screens.layout: Top-level metric widgets (Revenue, Total Appointments). Grid of management modules (Manage Barbers, Manage Services, etc.). Utility-focused but maintains luxe aesthetic using brandTertiary tints.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6 Glass / Luxe personality. Maintain a dark, cinematic, and expensive mood using the midnight black (`surface`) and antique gold (`brandPrimary`) palette.
Typography: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' exclusively for display headings/titles to establish authority. Use 'Switzer' for all body text, labels, and booking metrics.
Text Over Images: ALWAYS implement a vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> ≥70% surfaceInverse) whenever text is placed over imagery (e.g., Barber profile banners, Auth background).

Sticky CTAs: For screens with scrolling content and a primary action (e.g., Booking Flow, Home), wrap the primary 'Book'/'Continue' CTA in a sticky fixed container at the bottom with safe-area clearance and a glassmorphism/gradient background.
Glassmorphism: Apply `expo-blur` heavily on bottom tab bars, sticky headers, and featured cards. Ensure the background behind glass has a minimum 75% surface tint so foreground text is readable.
Haptics: Wire haptics directly to primary button presses, tab changes, and time-slot selections in the booking flow. Ensure they are serialized in the components.
Layouts: Treat the home screen as a launchpad, not a poster. A dominant CTA and availability indicators must be instantly visible. Avoid dense dashboard clutter for clients.
Icons: Stick to 'Ionicons', consistently outlined or consistently filled per screen.
